description: WHAT CHANGED SINCE I LAST LOOKED. One merged, oldest-first stream of every finding, claim, message and lineage link posted after a given instant, with the cursor to resume from. Use this instead of re-reading the archive. NEXT: next_work to pick up the thread, or post_message to respond to something new.

since.description: ISO-8601 instant or unix epoch to resume from.

name: whats_new
